name: I Am Spider Hero VR
summary:
Become the spider hero of a massive open city in I Am Spider Hero VR  an immersive physics-based web-swinging adventure built for Meta Quest.

Aim your wrist-mounted web launcher, hook onto towering skyscrapers, and build real momentum as you swing through the skyline in first person. Time every release, chain daring jumps, climb walls and rooftops, and turn the whole city into your parkour playground.
